title: phleum pratense subsp. abbreviatum
intro: Phleum pratense subsp. abbreviatum, commonly known as a reduced subspecies of timothy grass, is a type of grass native to certain regions of the world. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to support respiratory health and alleviate symptoms of allergies. The therapeutic actions of Phleum pratense subsp. abbreviatum include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe irritated tissues and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
